content: Apple states simulators do not replicate physical-device performance or features; performance tests should use realistic conditions, Release builds, no debugger, and baseline comparisons. XCTOSSignpostMetric measures matching begin/end regions. Project inference: separate software event timing from audible cue latency, gather labeled clip and physical-device baselines, freeze acceptance bounds before validation, and report pending evidence instead of fabricated thresholds. Sources: https://developer.apple.com/documentation/xcode/running-your-app-on-simulated-or-physical-devices ; https://developer.apple.com/documentation/xcode/writing-and-running-performance-tests ; https://developer.apple.com/documentation/xctest/xctossignpostmetric
